The appointment booking system is terrible. They tell you to call, but they don't answer and hang up. What's the point of calling? The doctor is good, and the price isn't expensive, but they should change the counter staff. They're slow and incompetent. You can call forever and they still won't answer.

It's extremely difficult to contact them. I called 10-20 times before they finally answered, even though they could have pressed the answer button but chose not to. I've never been able to get through to schedule an appointment. I'm very disappointed. When I arrived at the clinic, the nurse at the front desk asked if I had made an appointment. When I told them I had called but no one answered, they kept making excuses, even though I had been calling from 5 PM until 7 PM and no one answered!

The doctor provides good service, but the system needs improvement. Appointments must be booked in advance by phone only. There is no system for issuing receipts. If you need a receipt, you have to come in, provide your name, and then come back the next day to pick it up, which is very time-consuming.

This is the worst clinic I've ever been to. The doctor did a very superficial examination with just a quick glance, and there were no medications available for visual inspection. Isn't 400฿ an excessive fee?
